persons.name: Bhūpatīndra
persons.evidence: śrī3 bhūpatīndramahārājādhirājana thva sāphuli saṃpūrṇṇana khāṅā va dayakā dina julo

date.as_written: samvat 813 jyeṣṭhamāse śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ tithau puṣyanakṣatre dhruvayoge ādityavāsare bṛṣarāśi(ga)te savitari karkkatarāśigate candramasi

notes: Bhūpatīndra Malla of Bhaktapur caused the book (sāphuli) to be completed/made on this day (dayakā dina julo).
